fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Adversaries can carry out malicious operations using a virtual instance to avoid detection. This rule is built to detect the registration of the Virtualbox driver or start of a Virtualbox VM.
fields.name: Virtualbox Driver Installation or Starting of VMs
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((tgt.process.cmdline contains "VBoxRT.dll,RTR3Init" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "VBoxC.dll" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "VBoxDrv.sys") or (tgt.process.cmdline contains "startvm" or tgt.process.cmdline contains "controlvm")))
